:::{#sol-orthogonal-complement-practice}

Here

$$
\ba
(1, 2, 0) \cdot (2, -1, 3) &= 2 - 2 + 0 = 0,
\\
(0, 3, 1) \cdot (2, -1, 3) &= 0 - 3 + 3 = 0,
\ea
$$

so $(2, -1, 3)$ is [orthogonal](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-orthogonal-vectors) to both vectors of $\mathcal{X}$,
and it is in $\mathcal{X}^\perp$.

:::
